params.name: left
params.description: New absolute left coordinate, in pixels from the form's top-left corner.

params.name: top
params.description: New absolute top coordinate, in pixels from the form's top-left corner.

params.name: right
params.description: New absolute right coordinate; if it does not match the object's width after left/top are applied, the object is resized.

params.name: bottom
params.description: New absolute bottom coordinate; if it does not match the object's height after left/top are applied, the object is resized.

overloads.semanticRole: Sets the absolute location and, optionally, the size of the designated form object for the current process.

discriminatedBy.rule: When '*' is passed, object is an object name (Text) identifying the target by name; when '*' is omitted, object must be a direct Variable or Field reference.

jointConstraints.rule: right/bottom are optional together; when given, they redefine the object's size (resizing it) rather than just its position.

constraints: Equivalent to OBJECT MOVE with its absolute-coordinates trailing '*' passed.
Only functions in: input forms in entry mode, forms displayed via DIALOG, headers/footers of output forms displayed by MODIFY SELECTION/DISPLAY SELECTION, and forms being printed.
To move an object relative to its current position, use OBJECT MOVE instead.
